map.药物诱导免疫性血小板减少症（DITP）风险评估，基于用药史与血小板动态变化判断因: Drug-induced immune thrombocytopenia (DITP) risk assessment, judging causality from the medication history and platelet dynamics
map.血小板减少时按用药史与 PLT 动态评估 DITP 可能性: When platelets drop, assess the likelihood of DITP from the medication history and the PLT dynamics
map.药物类别（肝素/奎宁/抗生素等）+ 下降幅度 + 时间窗 + 恢复模式 加权: Drug class (heparin / quinine / antibiotics etc.) + drop magnitude + time window + recovery pattern, weighted
map.高风险药物（肝素）改用 4Ts 单独评 HIT: For high-risk drugs such as heparin, use 4Ts to score HIT separately
map.：DITP 加权：药物类别（高4/中3/低2/其他1）、血小板下降幅度（≥80%: DITP weighting: drug class (high 4 / medium 3 / low 2 / other 1), platelet drop magnitude (>=80% -> 4, >=50% -> 3, >=30% -> 2, <30% -> 1), time window (1-14 days on the drug -> 3), recovery (1-7 days after stopping -> 3), plus positive clinical features; the composite percentage gives high / moderate / low likelihood.
map.：例（高风险药物、PLT 180→15 即降 91.7%、起病第 5 天、停药第: Example (high-risk drug, PLT 180 -> 15, a drop of 91.7%, onset on day 5, recovery on day 7 after stopping, no additional features): class 4 + drop 4 + time window 3 + recovery 3 + features 0 = 14 points (out of 14, 100%) -> "highly likely"; stop the drug permanently at once and record the allergy history.
map.所有药物都套这个评分吗？: Does This Score Apply to Every Drug?
map.肝素类不套此工具，须用 4Ts 评分单独评估 HIT（肝素诱导血栓风险特殊，即便: Heparin-type drugs do not use this tool; score HIT (heparin-induced thrombocytopenia) separately with 4Ts, since thrombosis risk is special and can occur even when platelets are not extremely low. Other drugs can use this weighted method for a first causal judgment.
map.下降幅度 ≥80% 为何权重最高？: Why Does a Drop of >=80% Carry the Highest Weight?
map.血小板短时间内骤降（尤其伴出血）最支持药物破坏机制；缓慢小幅下降更可能源于基础病: A sharp platelet drop within a short time (especially with bleeding) supports a drug destruction mechanism; a slow, small decline is more likely from an underlying disease or other factors, so the magnitude of the drop is one of the core clues to causal strength.
